From Japan’s plague-infected flea bombs and the horrors of Unit 731 to Britain’s anthrax experiments on Gruinard Island, World War II saw terrifying advances in biological warfare. Discover the deadly weapons, secret experiments, and abandoned plans to spread disease, including a proposed biological attack on the United States.
